representation: Rust facade contract description; not a general JSON codec
semantics: No Modelica same-time event iteration or solver selection. Host owns cadence.
This descriptor is descriptive, not a runtime/profile selector or a snapshot-format revision.
Existing state wire revision, execution ABI, catalog fingerprint and executable compatibility checks are unchanged.
Only complete typed frames execute. Ordinary preparation/execution refusals precede mutation; no Store reads or writes occur.

types.Pre: call-entry memory output, then latch current input for next successful call
types.PreparedInputFrame: opaque owned complete observations and finite nondecreasing f64 model seconds; consumed once by execute_frame
types.CompletedFrame: immutable lexical boundary outputs, ordered warnings and engine-lifetime monotonic sequence; not a durable replay identity
types.transition: one state advance for every successful call, including equal timestamps
